patternMessages.^[a-z][a-z0-9]*_[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.:-]*$: Expected a reference: lowercase prefix, exactly one underscore, then lowercase letters, digits, '.', ':' or '-' (e.g. contribution_method-fixture)

refinements.source:
(record, context) => { if (!record.supportingEvidenceIds.length && !record.contradictingEvidenceIds.length && !record.qualifyingEvidenceIds.length && !record.limitations.length)
    context.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["limitations"], message: "Claim must have evidence or an explicit limitation" }); }

(record, context) => { if (record.openDefectIds.length)
    context.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["openDefectIds"], message: "Direction closure cannot contain open defects" }); }

(value, context) => { if (value.trace.lastSequence < value.trace.firstSequence)
    context.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["trace", "lastSequence"], message: "lastSequence must not precede firstSequence" }); }

(record, context) => { if (record.claimAudit.unresolvedClaimIds.length || record.openDefectIds.length)
    context.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["openDefectIds"], message: "Mission completion cannot contain unresolved claims or defects" }); }

(value, context) => { if (value.kind === "research_direction" && !value.decisionUse)
    context.addIssue({ code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom, path: ["decisionUse"], message: "A research_direction spawn needs decisionUse: what the answer will decide" }); }

(value, context) => { if ((value.executionMode === "program") !== (value.programId !== null))
    context.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["programId"], message: "program mode requires programId and prompt mode forbids it" }); }
